purpose: Test whether the receiver-local response to B's exact realized parameter update changes across each receiver's actual native training transition.

donor_update.label: B
donor_update.semantics: The exact named parameter delta from B's actual native training step; receiver-local Adam state is preserved.

response_contract.numeric: Compute central J and K at each native-full receiver state and the exact plus-one response for every floating CSRG-4C output.
response_contract.categorical: Preserve raw baseline, signed and plus-one categorical outcomes and exact transition masks; never subtract or average labels.
response_contract.probe: CSRG-4C-v1: two baselines, four single-component gates and six pair-component gates for every branch state.

adjudication.transport_support: For both receivers, native-full J must differ from skip J beyond exact replay and must predict the same native-full plus-one target better than the skip J for all 42 nonzero numeric roles; the reciprocal skip target comparison is evaluated by the external transport validator.
adjudication.transport_falsification: If J remains byte-identical across the native transition or receiver-state registration provides no residual improvement, the response-transport hypothesis fails for this update.
adjudication.observation_omission: Only identical complete numeric and categorical response objects with different exact plus-one raw or capability outcomes support observation omission.
adjudication.scope: This is an h1 response-state transport test across one actual native training transition, not a long-horizon stability closure.
